text_block_list.text:
I found Transcend's smartphone in the 
trainer's office. She must have left it 
behind when she came by earlier.

Thinking she would be at a loss without 
it, I decided to search for Transcend.

I found Transcend right away. She was with 
some friends, so as I was waiting for the 
right moment to speak to her—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chan, have you tried the pastries 
from that shop? They had a ton of new 
stuff out, didn't they~?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I went with an anchovy bun and a 
savory bun packed with bacon♪ They were 
both super delicious!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh~ I'll have to try that next time!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Pokke-chan. What was that song you 
were just humming?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's the next assigned song. Dammit, 
I've danced to it so many times it's stuck 
in my head.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's so true~.

Transcend strikes up casual small talk 
with every friend she meets, then briskly 
walks on.

Because of that, I couldn't time it right 
and ended up tailing behind her. At this 
rate, I'll look like a total suspicious 
person.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh? Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Why are you running, what's wrong? Is it 
an emergency?

When I explain that I had forgotten my 
phone and ended up chasing after her as a 
result...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you really didn't need to worry 
about it~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks. I took all my notes on 
paper, so I didn't even notice I was 
missing my phone.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. If you were following me, you saw it, 
right? My intel gathering.

"...Could this be what they were talking 
about with their friends?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, did they not notice?

Prompted by those words, I try to recall 
the conversation—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! I chose the anchovy bread and a 
savory pastry packed with lots of bacon♪ 
It was super delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
""Huh? It's the next assigned song. 
Dammit, I've danced to it so many times 
that it's completely stuck in my head.""

...The bread we ate. The assigned song. 
Could this really serve as some kind of 
clue...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's a word association game. Trainy, you 
get it, right?

A word association game... I try thinking 
it through myself. And then, I voiced what 
I suspected.
choice_data_list:
The bread I chose turned out to be really 
salty...

Focus on the "over and over" part rather 
than the "set piece"?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Normally she'd prioritize sweet 
things, but this time they were all super 
salty.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In other words... there's a chance you're 
deficient in minerals.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't think it's anything worth 
worrying about, though. Maybe I'll bring 
by some nutritious treats or something.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ta-da.

Transcend puffs out her chest playfully. I 
couldn't help but admire how she managed 
to pry that much information out of such a 
brief conversation.

When I gave her my honest praise, 
Transcend smiled, this time looking just a 
little bit shy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, there are moves in those 
assigned songs that you're not good at.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If we analyze that... maybe we'll 
discover a surprising amount of things?"

Transcend raised a hand to her glasses. To 
take that one phrase and extrapolate this 
far...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You're exaggerating!

Transcend laughed, perhaps finding my 
heartfelt remark amusing. It seems her 
information-gathering skills will continue 
to surprise me in the future.
